If sentiment is consistently positive (≥0.67) in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 1.5–2.5% in late horizon (day 25–30) to avoid over-optimism.  
If sentiment is consistently negative (≤-0.33) in the last 3 days, increase forecast by 1.5–2.5% in early horizon (day 1–10) to counteract pessimism.  
When sentiment swings from positive to negative over 2 consecutive days, reduce forecast slope by 0.5–1.0% per day in mid horizon (day 11–20) to smooth abrupt reversals.  
If sentiment is neutral (0.00–0.33) and forecast is trending upward, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.0% in late horizon to prevent overcorrection.  
If sentiment is neutral and forecast is trending downward, increase forecast by 0.5–1.0% in early horizon to prevent premature bottoming.  
When sentiment peaks at 1.00 and follows a 3-day downtrend, reduce forecast by 1.0–1.5% in mid horizon to avoid overcorrection after momentum reversal.
